intro.text: A Thaylen Shardbearer of the highguard in Thaylen City, who helps fight a thunderclast in the Battle of Thaylen Field.

items.text: Born into one of the eight old Thaylen houses that own Shards, Hrdalm served in the highguard protecting the Thaylen throne.

In 1174 Hrdalm joined Adolin against the thunderclast, acting as a distraction. Pinned by two Fused, he was saved when Adolin threw his Blade at one. On a lower tier he found Adolin hurt and told him to rest; Adolin lent him the Blade, and with Renarin distracting the thunderclast, Hrdalm cut its legs off at the knees.

appearance.text: Usually seen in his family's black Shardplate, Cvaderln, its helm crested with stylised Thaylen eyebrows like swept-back knives and its skirt patterned with interlocking scales.

personality.text: Jovial and helpful, and deeply grateful when Adolin lent him his Shardblade.
